name: Alex Moon
originStory: You were born to Elena Moon and Daniel Moon, married nine years by the time you arrived. She was an accountant, he was an architect. Nothing extravagant, but nobody checked the price of things. You were the youngest of 3: Thomas and Olga were already running the house. Your mother Elena never left the house without her face on, and taught you the same. In Amsterdam, in 2026. Nobody there had any idea what you would become.

timeline.text: Born in Amsterdam to Elena Moon and Daniel Moon — a comfortable household.

productions.title: Paper Cousin
productions.premise: A daughter who stayed away too long comes back to a terrace due for clearance. A will leaves everything to one of them, and it is too late to be fair about it.
